Output ONE single full-body red panda, centered, front three-quarter view, on a plain warm off-white background. Never show a sheet, grid, multiple characters, or multiple views. Preserve the reference's rust-red head, cream cheek crescents and ear rims, dark-brown headband, dark-brown compact body, lighter brown paws, broad striped tail, and a single bright orange #FF7A1F wristband. Preserve its confident adult personality and expressive eyes. This is polished flat 2D character animation with clean curved silhouettes and solid colors. The arms have natural rounded shoulder transitions, gently tapered upper arms, soft elbow bends, and expressive rounded paws: they belong organically to the body. No straight stick arms, no detached circular joints, no puppet construction. The other paw stays relaxed near the hip. A small delayed tail sway and subtle ear follow-through support the gesture. Feet remain planted. Maintain consistent proportions, face markings, accessories and tail stripes throughout. Locked camera, entire character and tail visible with generous margins, no cuts, no zoom, no camera movement. No text, props, speech, audio, gradients, fur texture, photorealism, or 3D rendering. Aim for a finished hand-animated mascot performance.
